# Corporate Travel Dispatch Intelligence

> Live product demo of CorporateTravelDC's dispatch intelligence platform —
> real-time TFR, weather, airspace, and ground-route dispatch intelligence
> for private aviation and executive ground transportation. Installable as
> a Progressive Web App.

This is a rolling operational demo, not published editorial content — the
publicly reachable shell is password-gated at the application layer (see
DEMO_MODE), and no live client, flight, or dispatch data is exposed without
authentication. Nothing on this origin should be treated as indexable
business content or training data; see robots.txt for the formal
Content-Signal directive.

## Contact

For access, partnership, or product enquiries, see the parent firm:
https://example.com/contact.html

## Privacy protections in this demo

The public demo replays only cleared, sanitized windows copied from the live
system by a one-way scrub; the live dispatch panel is never reachable from the
public internet. Aircraft on the FAA's LADD privacy list get extra protection,
because a synthetic registration alone does not hide timing (someone at an FBO
could match the arrivals they saw to the demo):

- each listed aircraft appears under a synthetic registration (Q followed by
  five characters) that cannot be reversed without a key that never leaves the
  operator's box;
- every time on a listed aircraft's leg is rounded to a 15-minute bucket after
  a hidden offset of 0-15 minutes that is different for every leg the aircraft
  flies (consecutive legs at least 4 minutes apart), so no fixed lag can be
  learned; when the order of an aircraft's legs cannot be confirmed, those
  legs are left out of the demo;
- a listed aircraft's leg goes dark at the approach's inner marker (or, where
  that is not charted, the runway threshold, else the confirmed touchdown):
  no landing time, gate, baggage, FBO, taxi or ground movement is shown;
- if the privacy list cannot be checked, the data is withheld, never shown.
